text: 周四（10月29日）欧市尾盘，德国10年期国债收益率跌1.6个基点，报3.355%，日内交投于3.385%-3.317%区间，北京时间20:06微涨并刷新日高，随后呈现出W形走势，欧洲央行宣布按兵不动、美国GDP和PCE数据发布后，在欧洲央行行长拉加德新闻发布会期间刷新日低。 两年期德债收益率跌5.6个基点，报3.075%，日内交投于3.126%-3.040%区间，全天处于下跌状态，欧洲央行在21:15宣布按兵不动之后加速下跌，23:34刷新日低，媒体报道称，欧洲央行准备在12月加息之后再次暂停紧缩；30年期德债收益率涨1.6个基点，报3.701%。 2
text_en: Thursday (Oct 29) late European session: German 10-year Bund yield fell 1.6 bps to 3.355%, trading intraday in a 3.385%-3.317% range; edged up around 20:06 Beijing time to refresh the day's high, then traced a W-shaped path, refreshing the day's low during ECB President Lagarde's press conference after the ECB announced it was holding steady and US GDP and PCE data were released. The 2-year German yield fell 5.6 bps to 3.075%, trading intraday in a 3.126%-3.040% range, falling throughout the day, accelerating lower after the ECB announced it was holding steady at 21:15, and refreshing the day's low at 23:34; media reports said the ECB is prepared to pause tightening again after a December rate hike; the 30-year German yield rose 1.6 bps to 3.701%. 2
